CTA

"I've put the whole method into five short audio series. £27 for all five. Tap Learn more."

Script 2 · "The meeting"

Hook (0 to 3s)

"Here's how to get your point across in a meeting without raising your voice."

Body

"Slow down. Breathe low. Land the end of your sentence instead of letting it rise like a question. People hear authority in how a sentence ends, not how loud it is."

CTA

"Meetings with Gravitas is one of five series in my Collection. Tap Learn more."

Shot: walk-and-talk, cut to text "land the sentence".
